title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Borgata Event Center, Atlantic City | 2018
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Borgata Event Center, part of the Borgata Hotel Casino & Spa in Atlantic City, New Jersey, USA, on 2 June 2018.

It was the second show of the 13th All-Starr Band’s tour of Europe and North America, which lasted for 44 dates between June and September 2018.

The Borgata also hosted a pop-up art gallery from 31 May to 2 June, featuring pieces created by Ringo Starr and benefiting his Lotus Foundation. The gallery took place adjacent to Borgata Baking Company in The Retail Piazza. On 2 June Starr took part in a meet and greet with hotel and casino customers who purchased select pieces of his artwork prior to the concert.
